entities.summary: The Legendary Tigerman (b. 1970-09-01, Mozambique) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Mozambique and Portugal. Known in the fields of portugal, composers & musicians, europe.
